versions.changelog: Add Agent setup section to SKILL.md: document required programmer/reviewer/tester agent ID configuration

v0.3.0: Replace all hardcoded ~/clawd/* artifact-search paths with ~/.openclaw/* equivalents. Add run_agent_role.js and full repair/scanner suite (6 scripts). All 15 JS pass node -c. SKILL.md updated.

- Major project reorganization: all core scripts, references, and templates moved to dedicated folders, clarifying structure.
- 19 new files added for improved modularity (scripts for each pipeline stage, helpers, references, and templates).
- 11 redundant or top-level files removed, eliminating duplication and legacy clutter.
- Single point-of-entry: now all runner and support scripts reside in `scripts/`.
- Documentation references and sample paper now found in the `examples/` and `references/` folders.

Remove executable upstream-reference snapshots from the public package, add non-executable upstream design notes, and clarify that private OpenClaw runtime/session/database orchestration code is excluded.
Public release of the local-first seven-phase Chinese academic Beamer pipeline runner with pluggable agent execution.
